note: Tables were read from the RUPTL PDF with PyMuPDF. Stray spaces inside numbers (e.g. '3 7.601') were removed; '.' is the thousands separator and ',' the decimal point, except where a value has a single digit after '.' (e.g. '202.8' MtCO2), which is read as a decimal.
RUPTL historical generation for Sumatera is only published together with Kalimantan (Sumkal). Kalimantan has no geothermal plants, so the geothermal row is Sumatera's. Other fuels cannot be split.
RUPTL 'Sumatera' projections cover the whole Sumatera region, including island systems and Bangka (planned to join the grid); slightly wider than the ESDM decree's Sumatera grid.
From the 2030s, Jamali's projected hydro and geothermal include energy imported from Sumatera over the Sumatera-Java interconnection (ISJ), per the table footnote. Jamali solar includes rooftop PV.
2024 historical generation is unaudited and runs to October only; it is kept but flagged and excluded from trend charts. 2024 sales are a forecast (prognosa).
BIO HSD (diesel blended with biodiesel) is grouped with oil. 'EBT' and 'BBM' subtotal rows are not stored, to avoid double counting; they are rebuilt from their components and checked.
RUPTL covers PLN's system (own plants, rented plants and IPPs). Captive industrial plants are excluded, so totals are lower than Ember's national figures.
